teaser.en: Small yellow star-shaped flowers mark this bush shrub, one of the most popular medicines among the Digo.

summary.en: *Mkone* is a Grewia shrub of the coastal bushland, with toothed three-veined leaves and small yellow star flowers. It is one of the popular Digo medicines.

about.en: *Mkone* is a shrub or small tree. Its leaves are toothed along the edges and have three main veins running from the base, a Grewia trademark. The flowers are small yellow stars, and they are followed by small round fruits.

uses.en: It is a popular Digo medicine. Grewia fruits are also widely eaten as snacks in East Africa.

names.en: The name *mkone* is shared across Digo, Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Grewia plagiophylla*.

reason.en: Another coastal bush shrub used as medicine
Another popular Digo medicine of the bush
